flagged.evidence: The page says framed 0-manififolds of S^n are classified by signed count without restricting n. For n=0, S^0 has two points with opposite standard orientation signs, so the full set and the empty set both have signed count 0. They are not framed cobordant: a rank-zero cobordism in S^0×I is a union of whole component intervals, so occupancy at the two ends agrees. The in-scope zero-manifold example supplies the missing n≥1 hypothesis.

The page says, “Since the equator is the equatorial stabilization of the equator one dimension lower.” The current definition of stabilization sends a d-dimensional submanifold N to i(N), still d-dimensional, in an ambient sphere of dimension one higher. Thus stabilizing S^(m−2)⊂S^(m−1) yields dimension m−2 in S^m, not the equator S^(m−1)⊂S^m.
